✨ Maya | Swift
🎯 Primary Use Case: Transforming raw iPhone screen recordings into professional, shareable video content for marketing, social media, and tutorials.
✨ Key Features: • Device framing with multiple iPhone/iPad/MacBook models and color variants • Customizable generic frames and no-frame option • Configurable canvas aspect ratios (1:1, 9:16, 4:5, etc.) • Optional drop shadows
📖 Summary: Maya is a native macOS application designed to enhance iPhone screen recordings by adding professional visual elements. It allows users to wrap recordings in device frames, incorporate cinematic zoom effects, add visible tap feedback, and export polished videos suitable for marketing, social media, or tutorials.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 crosspaste-desktop | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Seamlessly synchronize clipboard content across multiple devices on a local network, ensuring privacy and security.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time Sharing • Cross-platform (macOS, Windows, Linux) • Rich Type Support (Text, Color, URL, HTML, RTF, Image, File) • End-to-End Encryption • LAN-only Serverless Architecture
📖 Summary: CrossPaste Desktop is a cross-platform application for synchronizing clipboard content between macOS, Windows, and Linux devices. It prioritizes privacy with end-to-end encryption and a serverless, LAN-only architecture, also featuring OCR and CLI capabilities.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 cashclaw | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automate the process of finding, bidding on, executing, and learning from tasks in an onchain work marketplace, acting as a self-improving digital worker.
✨ Key Features: • Autonomous agent for task execution • Connects to Moltlaunch marketplace • LLM-powered work completion • Self-learning and improvement based on feedback • Tool-use for various agent actions (quote, decline, message, etc.)
📖 Summary: CashClaw is an open-source autonomous agent built with TypeScript that connects to the Moltlaunch marketplace to find, bid on, and complete tasks. It utilizes an LLM for task execution and incorporates a feedback loop to continuously improve its performance over time.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 davy | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Watching current season anime on Android TV devices.
✨ Key Features: • Browse current season anime • Detailed anime pages (synopsis, genres, ratings) • Select episodes and players • Built-in ExoPlayer media player • TV-friendly layout with focus-based navigation
📖 Summary: DAVY is a modern Android TV application built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for discovering and watching anime from the current season. It features a TV-friendly interface, a built-in media player powered by ExoPlayer, and pulls data from the Yummy API for a seamless discovery-to-playback experience.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 nyetdb | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable AI agents to safely query databases without the risk of accidental data modification or unauthorized access, by providing a secure, read-only interface.
✨ Key Features: • Read-only access across multiple database types • Layered security: AST validation, session modes, read-only roles • Project-scoped connections based on directory access • Password management, keeping credentials out of agent reach
📖 Summary: NyetDB is a Rust-based CLI tool designed to provide AI agents with secure, read-only access to various databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis). It acts as a secure gateway, preventing unauthorized write operations and protecting sensitive data through multiple layers of security and logging.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
